name: lossless-compactor
description: Zero-LLM compaction rebuilt from the full transcript, with session recall (port of @pi-unipi/compactor)

method.title: Compaction method
method.description: lossless builds the summary with no model call; llm uses Claude Code's own model-written summary.

autoCompactWindow.title: Auto-compact window (tokens)
autoCompactWindow.description: Sets Claude Code's autoCompactWindow; it auto-compacts a buffer below this. 0 leaves Claude Code's own.

summaryBudgetTokens.title: Summary budget (tokens)
summaryBudgetTokens.description: Size of the lossless summary. 0 is auto (1.5k to 4k, at most 8% of the window).

smartKeepTail.title: Smart keep tail
smartKeepTail.description: Keeps more recent turns when the kept tail would be under 5k tokens (up to 25k).

notify.title: Notify
notify.description: Shows a toast after each automatic compaction. Failures always show.
